name: 陳心怡
objective:
本課程為英語教學相關領域之研究生設計，適合師資培育中的職前教師、現職英語教師，以及有志於成為語言教師之學習者選修。課程全面探討人工智慧 (AI) 於語言教學與學習中的理論基礎與應用實務，旨在增進教師的 AI 素養（AI literacy），使學員能理解並善用 AI 技術於課堂教學與評量之中，並且協助學生理解 AI 在語言學習中的理論架構。
This course is designed for pre-service English teachers, in-service educators, and those interested in becoming language teachers. It explores both the theoretical foundations and practical applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in language teaching and learning, with a focus on English language education. A core component of the course is developing AI literacy, enabling students to critically understand, evaluate, and responsibly use AI tools in educational settings. Students will engage with key learning theories that inform the integration of AI into language education. These theories support informed decision-making about how AI technologies are used to enhance teaching and learning.
schedule:

課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）● 深入探討 AI 的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
